name: Delta Electronics, Inc. (2308.TW) - Taiwan Stock Exchange, prices and targets in TWD
upcoming_dates: 2026-10-28 | earnings | Q3 2026 results and analyst meeting, Yahoo estimated earnings date | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/2308.TW/ | aggregator
product: Power electronics including switching power supplies, DC-to-DC modules and adapters; thermal management including fans, liquid cooling and climate systems; EV power electronics and traction; industrial automation and motion; infrastructure such as UPS, data-centre power, EV charging, energy storage and PV inverters.
demand: AI data-centre construction is the growth engine, pulling power and liquid-cooling demand across hyperscale and colocation builds. Industrial automation and EV-related demand are comparatively softer, so the mix is tilting toward AI infrastructure.
pricing_power: Moderate. Bundled integrated energy-to-compute solutions plus NVIDIA DSX alignment support pricing, but rising component and memory costs, reported by Reuters about 2026-05, and intense competition limit gross-margin expansion despite positive mix.
competition: Vertiv, Schneider Electric, Eaton and ABB in data-centre power and cooling; Asia Vital Components and Auras in thermal; Lite-On, Chicony and FSP in power supplies; plus Chinese power and cooling suppliers.
team: Chairman Ping Cheng; Delta founded 1971, headquartered in Taipei, 85,684 employees per stockanalysis.com company profile. Leadership detail beyond the chairman was not found on the English IR pages read 2026-09-25.
market_strategy: Bundle AI data-centre power at 800 VDC with liquid cooling and prefabricated modular data centres, claimed up to 60 percent faster deployment at COMPUTEX 2026-06-02, deepen the NVIDIA partnership and expand manufacturing footprint via the Johor Bahru office 2026-07-28.
bull: Delta bundles 800 VDC power, liquid cooling and prefab AI data-centre modules with NVIDIA DSX (PR Newswire 2026-09-18, 2026-09-21); Sep-quarter revenue seen +39.8% y/y with FY2026 gross margin about 36.3% vs 34.3%.
bear: Q2 2026 EPS beat only 0.59% after Q1 -6.14% and Q4 2025 -11.83% misses; Reuters about 2026-05 flagged rising input costs; stock fell 12-14% over the past week and month; PE about 60.6, beta 1.5.
falsifier: Q3 2026 results on 2026-10-28: gross margin below 34.3% or an EPS miss would show AI power and cooling demand is not converting into the guided margin expansion.
